The RetryAllocation use case. Re-attempts allocation for the order's `Backordered` lines and ONLY those lines — it is the single sanctioned route from `Backordered` back to `Allocated`, and it is what unblocks a ship-complete order held back by BR3.

A line still short of stock stays `Backordered` (no error). The same fail-closed rule as allocate applies to any non-409 failure. An order with no backordered line at all is rejected with `409`: retrying an order that is not backordered is a caller mistake, not a no-op.
